'''Kelric''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as [[Supreme Commander]] in the military forces of [[House of Organa/Legends|House Organa]], a [[Great Houses of Alderaan|noble house]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] aligned with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] in the [[Alderaan Civil War]]. He was stationed in the northern section of the [[House Organa (estate)|Organa estate]], in the [[Glarus Valley]], but was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial forces]].
